map.Bennett 近似在什么范围适用？: In what range is the Bennett approximation valid?
map.→ 打开折射量（R = 1.02 / tan(h + 10.3/(h+5.11): -> Open the refractive index tool (R = 1.02 / tan(h + 10.3/(h+5.11)) ')
map.为什么接近地平线折射最明显？: Why is refraction strongest near the horizon?
map.在低高度角观测时，近地面大气使天体视高度被抬升，用 Bennett 近似估算折射: At low elevation angles, the atmosphere near the ground lifts the apparent altitude of a celestial object; use the Bennett approximation to estimate refraction and correct the telescope pointing.
map.在天文导航或测地观测中，把观测到的视高度换算回真实高度角。: In astronomical navigation or geodetic observation, convert the observed apparent altitude back to the true altitude angle.
map.大气压与海拔转换（气压计读数）: Atmospheric pressure and altitude conversion (barometer reading)
map.对常规地面观测（约数度到天顶）足够好；极近地平线或要求毫角秒精度时需用更完整的折: Good enough for ordinary ground-based observation (a few degrees up to the zenith); very close to the horizon, or when milliarcsecond accuracy is required, a fuller refraction table plus pressure, temperature and water vapour must be considered.
map.对贴近地平线的太阳或月球做位置归算时，修正其看似被「压扁」和抬升的视位置。: When reducing the apparent position of the sun or moon near the horizon, correct the way it looks flattened and lifted.
map.示例：真高度角 30° 时的大气折射: Example: atmospheric refraction at a true altitude of 30 degrees
map.视线穿过的大气层路径随高度角降低而急剧变长，折射累积更大；高度角趋近 0° 时折: The atmospheric path the line of sight traverses grows sharply longer as the altitude angle drops, so refraction accumulates more; as the altitude angle approaches 0 degrees refraction reaches about 34 arcminutes, close to the apparent diameter of the sun.
map.输入天体真高度角，用Bennett近似公式（单位角分）计算近地面大气折射使其视高: Enter the true altitude of a celestial object and use the Bennett approximation formula (in arcminutes) to compute how much near-ground atmospheric refraction lifts its apparent altitude, for refraction correction in astronomical observation and telescope pointing.
map.近地面大气使天体视高度抬升（Bennett 近似，单位角分）。: Near-ground atmosphere lifts the apparent altitude of a celestial object (Bennett approximation, in arcminutes).
map.：代入 Bennett 公式 R=1.02/tan(h+10.3/(h+5.11: : substituting into the Bennett formula R = 1.02 / tan(h + 10.3/(h+5.11)) (in arcminutes), at h = 30 degrees the expression in brackets is about 30.29 degrees and tan is about 0.5846, giving R ~= 1.02 / 0.5846 ~= 1.74 arcminutes. The true position of the object is about 1.74 arcminutes lower than the observed apparent position.
